events.name: Frank Foster
events.info: Frank Foster embodies musical independence at its highest level. He not only has taken the road less traveled, but the road almost never traveled. Acting as his own record label, management and publishing company, he has managed to find success that some major label artists may never find. This rural Louisiana native and former oilfield man has taken his songs from the campfire to the coliseum seemingly overnight, all the while gaining a following of fans whose loyalty is unmatched.His musical journey started in 2011 with the release of his first album Rowdy Reputation. To follow that up, in the late summer of 2012, he released his second album Red Wings and Six Strings which debuted at #30 on the Billboard Country Charts and #1 on Billboards South Central U.S. Heat Seekers chart. Fosters next five albums also all debuted on the Billboard Country Charts. Southern Soul was released in 2013 debuting at #11. Rhythm and Whiskey was released in 2014 debuted at #4. His early 2016 release, Boots On The Ground, debuted at #7. Later in 2016, he released Good Country Music, which debuted at #13. In 2018, he released his seventh album, Til Im Gone, which debuted at #2 on the Billboard Country Album Sales Charts giving Foster his highest mark yet. Hes a singer, a songwriter and his own boss. He refuses to let anyone water down his kind of country music. If he lives it, he writes it; if he writes it, he sings it; if he sings it, he believes it. Frank Foster a true original.

events.name: Alabama Ballet Presents Unbound
events.info: Unbound is a thrilling mixed repertory program that celebrates bold artistry and the evolution of ballet. The evening opens with Seasons, choreographed by Paul Vasterling, set to Vivaldi's iconic score and filled with sweeping movement and vivid musical interpretation. Also featured is For Pixie, choreographed by Dani Rowe, an internationally acclaimed choreographer and Artistic Director of Oregon Ballet Theatre, known for her contemporary voice and emotional depth. The program concludes with Rubies, choreographed by George Balanchine, performed in celebration of its 60th anniversary and bursting with jazzy energy and neoclassical brilliance. Together, these works showcase a striking range of musical styles and choreographic approaches. Classical technique meets contemporary sensibility throughout the evening. Unbound offers audiences a bold and exhilarating ballet experience.

The Central Ticket Office is located at Legacy Arena, Entry A, 1898 9th Ave North, Birmingham, AL 35203. The Concert Hall and Theatre Box Office opens two hours before scheduled start time for most events. Hours may vary for some events.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: MC, VISA, AMX, DISCOVER and Cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available the day of the event at the Concert Hall/Theatre Box Office. For most events, will call opens two hours before the scheduled start time. Hours may vary for some events. Please bring a picture ID, the actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, and your order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Visit www.BJCC.org/plan-your-visit/directions-and-parking for a printable map and to pre-purchase parking. Parking prices vary by event and date. We aim to make navigating the BJCC campus simple using clear directions. With various parking options for events, conventions, and meetings, planning ahead ensures a smoother arrival. Since multiple events often occur simultaneously, arrive early to avoid long parking and entry lines.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available throughout the venue and can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com. Guests requiring accessible seating are guaranteed the ability to purchase at least one (1) companion seat. Subject to availability, guests requiring wheelchair seating may purchase up to a total of three (3) companion seats in the same row and contiguous with the wheelchair seat. If contiguous seats have already been sold, seats as close as possible to the wheelchair seat and adjacent companion seat will be offered. If you purchased a ticket in the fixed seating area but require an accessible seat, the Ticket Office may be able to assist you by relocating your ticket to an accessible seat. Please contact the Ticket Office at CTO@bjcc.org if you have any questions or require assistance purchasing tickets. Tickets are subject to availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: The following items are not permitted to be brought into the Complex at any time: laser pointers, food or beverages, glass containers, weapons, cameras, audio or video recorders. The BJCC reserves the right to search all guests entering the Complex and refuse entry at the discretion of management. This is a Smoke Free Facility smoking allowed in designated areas only.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children who have celebrated their 2nd birthday are required to have a ticket. For show specific age restrictions that may supersede our standard policy, visit www.bjcc.org/events

events.name: Alabama Ballet Presents Unbound
events.info: Unbound is a thrilling mixed repertory program that celebrates bold artistry and the evolution of ballet. The evening opens with Seasons, choreographed by Paul Vasterling, set to Vivaldi's iconic score and filled with sweeping movement and vivid musical interpretation. Also featured is For Pixie, choreographed by Dani Rowe, an internationally acclaimed choreographer and Artistic Director of Oregon Ballet Theatre, known for her contemporary voice and emotional depth. The program concludes with Rubies, choreographed by George Balanchine, performed in celebration of its 60th anniversary and bursting with jazzy energy and neoclassical brilliance. Together, these works showcase a striking range of musical styles and choreographic approaches. Classical technique meets contemporary sensibility throughout the evening. Unbound offers audiences a bold and exhilarating ballet experience.
events.pleaseNote: If you have celebrated your 2nd birthday, you must have a ticket.
